Bandhan Bank hit its all-time low of ₹152.20 during the 2020 COVID crash. Now, amid HMPV fears, it's broken that low again. 
Technically If it closes below this on the monthly chart, it confirms a major breakdown.
Coincidence or pattern?
#B
